review.assessment: This change creates solution.ts containing makeGrid, which uses fill to initialize rows with a single shared inner array. The acceptance check passed, but it does not validate row independence; the function fails the core requirement of isolating cell assignments across rows.

findings.call: node -e "const {makeGrid} = require('./solution'); const g = makeGrid(2, 3); g[0][0] = 5; console.log(g[1][0]);" (after compilation/loading)
findings.defect: Shared row references cause cell assignments to affect all rows.
